name: sil
description: Turn your OpenClaw into an expert shopping agent.

sil_web_url.description: Override for the sil-web origin (the auth authority — token refresh, registration). Falls back to the SIL_WEB_URL env var, then https://sil.4gpts.com.

sil_api_url.description: Override for the sil-api origin (the domain service — sil_whoami's identity read). Distinct from sil_web_url (sil-web). Falls back to the SIL_API_URL env var, then https://sil-api.4gpts.com. Set this at deploy to pin the sil-api host (or to the same origin as sil_web_url if a single gateway fronts both).

sil_web_url.label: sil-web URL (auth)
sil_web_url.help: The sil-web origin — handles registration and token refresh. Override only for staging or self-hosted deployments.

sil_api_url.label: sil-api URL (identity)
sil_api_url.help: The sil-api origin — sil_whoami reads the user's identity here. Distinct from the sil-web URL. Override for staging or self-hosted deployments.

security.packagingNote: What leaves your machine: only requests to the three hosts in networkEndpoints. sil.4gpts.com handles registration and token refresh. sil-api.4gpts.com serves catalog search and product lookup, called with your stored session token. clawhub.ai is read once, unauthenticated, to see whether a newer sil is published. Your shopper's artefacts and what it knows about you are never uploaded anywhere. What is stored on disk: everything sits under $SIL_DATA_DIR (see filesystemScope) - the credentials listed in credentialsOnDisk, plus the one shopper's markdown artefacts. Files are owner-only 0600, directories 0700, and every write is atomic (temp file, then rename), so a reader sees a whole file or none. What executes: compiled JavaScript under ./dist, loaded by the OpenClaw gateway. register() is synchronous - it registers tools plus one gateway RPC method (sil.search_results, scope operator.read, which hands a paired client back a search page held in memory) and opens no socket, port, or route. All I/O happens inside a tool call. What sil never does: it never logs or returns the contents of a token, never runs an install script, never loads a native module, and never starts a subprocess. It reports a newer version but never installs one. It overwrites no artefact it did not write, and anything that could lose data is reported for you to confirm, never done for you.
filesystemScope: $SIL_DATA_DIR (default $XDG_DATA_HOME/sil, else ~/.local/share/sil) - the only tree this plugin reads or writes on its own. Holds tokens.json and config.json, and the one shopper's artefacts under shopper/: the shared user_spec.md plus domains/<slug>/ with method.md, prds/<product>-<intent>.md and assets/. Markdown whose own frontmatter is the source of truth - there is no manifest file. The shopper/ segment is a compile-time constant; the domain slug and PRD key are the only caller-supplied path segments, each validated (lower-kebab, never main) before any join, so nothing escapes this tree. Files 0600, directories 0700, every write atomic.

The shopper's own workspace directory - chosen by the user at creation, confirmed before anything is written, and required to sit under the user's home. The host bootstraps it; sil writes the persona SOUL.md into it and nothing else.
